verdict.rationale: Community hands-on reports show Ollama running on an AMD GPU via shipped ROCm containers. Another report points to native MLX on Apple silicon, which suggests vendor-specific acceleration beyond NVIDIA. However, no first-party documentation in the pack covers GPU vendor support, and one user hit a 'no compatible rocm library' error that fell back to CPU. missing for 10: first-party documentation of supported GPU vendors and acceleration backends, any evidence of NVIDIA/CUDA support, coverage of other vendors (e.g. Intel/Vulkan), reliable ROCm detection without CPU fallback

support.subject: As a power-user, I can run models on NVIDIA, AMD, or other GPU vendors using vendor-specific acceleration kernels

citations.quote: I have been running Ollama on my AMD RX 6650 for weeks. They have shipped ROCm containers since 0.1.27.
native mlx should mean better memory handling on apple silicon.
